verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Splashing down in the Pacific Ocean on Friday near San Diego... at 8:07 p.m. Eastern time'; R3: 'splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT)'; R5: 'splashed down off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. ET'; R6: 'splashdown... around 5:07 p.m. PT in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact location, date, and time of the safe splashdown.
